Contract:
A single temporary scratch file for the current SDD session — `specs/.sdd-session.md`, gitignored, not a deliverable. It lets a multi-step or multi-scope flow survive a context squeeze or a session break within the same piece of work; it is NOT carried between unrelated sessions. The kernel reads it on entry and updates it after each loaded directive. On the work finishing, it is discarded.
The `scale:` field carries the operator-confirmed SCALE (`AX_SCALE_PROPORTIONAL_DEPTH`) — the router writes it once at classification; every branch reads it as its depth parameter (interview depth, number of design alternatives, weight of the verification tail). For `intent: project-setup` with no scope yet in play, the router still records `intent:` and the chosen branch at classification; `scale:` appears once a scope exists to size (root's own STEP_1/STEP_2 approval checks bind before any scope-level SCALE is meaningful).
The `glossary:` section is the session's terminology anchor (`AX_OPERATOR_LANGUAGE`): the first time a domain concept is named, `npx gennady sdd-session term " — "` appends it here; every later mention of that concept — in chat or in an artifact — reuses the recorded name verbatim. Before introducing a new name for something, check this list in the `sdd-state` snapshot first.
```markdown # SDD session — intent: scale: — operator-confirmed working set: - — — glossary: - — journal: - → open: ```
